mapper.sql: id, manhole_code, manhole_type, diameter, depth, status, ST_AsText(geom) AS geom_wkt, ST_X(geom) AS longitude, ST_Y(geom) AS latitude, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM manhole m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.geom IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pipe_main p WHERE p.id = #{pipeId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.geom IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin(p.geom::geography, m.geom::geography, #{radius}) ) ORDER BY m.id
